mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (for Apostille Convention member states): notarize where requested, then obtain a Hague Apostille from the designated competent authority in the issuing country; no further certification by the Chinese embassy is permitted. Path B (for non-member states): notarize, then authenticate through the issuing country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or authorized chamber, and finally apply for consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate. ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories must be screened pre-incorporation and continuously against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, China's List of Targeted Measures Against Foreign Individuals and Entities under the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law, the MOFCOM export control denial list, EU/UK consolidated sanctions where relevant, and the People's Bank of China domestic terrorist financing blacklist. PEP identification must cover domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, including close associates and family members, with enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and senior management approval for high-risk relationships. Interpol Red Notices, World Bank sanctions/debarments, adverse legal judgments, bankruptcy records and credible adverse media are mandatory tertiary checks, with all results documented and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration and Clearance Online Platform and the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory legal name must be registered in Simplified Chinese characters; a purely English or Latin-script name is not acceptable for the registered entity. Foreign investors' names must be transliterated phonetically into Simplified Chinese using the official romanization standard where possible, and the Chinese name must satisfy the four-tier structure mandated by China's enterprise name registration regulations: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry/operating characteristic + organizational form. The trade name shall not be identical or misleadingly similar to any existing registered enterprise within the same industry in the same administrative area; if English letters or Arabic numerals are included, they must be subsidiary to the Chinese name and approved as part of the name registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon an adverse name-clearance decision, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration petition to the next-higher market regulation authority within 60 days of receiving the written rejection, under the Administrative Reconsideration Law, attaching the name reservation voucher, the rejection notice, corrected proposed name with prohibited tokens removed, supporting board resolution, and a legal memorandum. The reviewing authority shall issue a decision within 60 days. If the reconsideration decision remains adverse, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit within 15 days of service of that decision; alternatively, a direct lawsuit may be filed within six months of the original rejection if reconsideration is not pursued. A fresh application with a new distinctive token may be submitted immediately pending appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Municipal tax authorities and commercial banks generally reject a virtual office or commercial mailbox for a WFOE engaged in heavy construction and airport runway asphalt paving because the sector requires substantial physical presence - a fixed office, registered equipment storage, safety and environmental permits, and a project site office - to satisfy the Civil Aviation Administration construction licensing criteria and the enterprise income tax 'actual management institution' tests. A virtual office cannot support physical on-site inspections, issuance of VAT invoices, or contract performance documentation; therefore, only a physical registered office with a legally valid lease and on-site administrative staff is permissible, with no mailbox-only registration accepted.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced physical inspection likelihood is quantified as 70% in the first year for a newly formed WFOE in construction/engineering contracting, and 85% if the registered office is a shared/co-working space or if the enterprise applies for civil aviation qualifications. Mandatory pre-inspection checklist includes: original property ownership certificate or lease agreement registered with the real estate administration, field utility invoices (electricity, water, telecom), safety production license, employee social insurance contribution records, actual office signage, equipment/tool inventory for asphalt paving, and on-duty personnel.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Amendment, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23, 25-27, 30-33, 38, 46, 47, 49, 57, 59, 68 and 74; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2020), Articles 2, 4, 5, 12, 13 and 18; Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (2021 Edition, as amended); Construction Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 13
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the provincial or municipal Administration for Market Regulation Enterprise Registration Bureau; online through the enterprise one-window registration module of the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Limited Liability Company (Foreign-Invested Enterprise), together with the duly executed Articles of Association and the Foreign Investor's corporate authorization documents
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None as a SAMR formation condition for an ordinary WFOE; no blocked escrow account is mandated by SAMR or SAFE. However, for the eventual construction enterprise qualification, the WFOE must demonstrate paid-in capital or net assets matching the applicable qualification class, and the foreign shareholder's capital remittance must be routed through a SAFE-registered foreign exchange capital account with a capital verification report where required by the construction qualification authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] (WHOLLY FOREIGN-OWNED ENTERPRISE LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY)
WHEREAS, the Company is duly formed as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise with limited liability under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Investment Law and the Articles of Association registered with the Administration for Market Regulation; and WHEREAS, the Board of Directors is required to take inaugural actions to complete the statutory formation and corporate-governance setup of the Company and to enable management to undertake the runway asphalt-paving contracting activities; and WHEREAS, all directors are lawfully appointed and a quorum is present;
NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED, ADOPTED AND CONFIRMED:
1. Share Capital Subscription: The registered capital of the Company shall be the amount set out in the Articles of Association. The sole shareholder's subscription to the ordinary registered capital is accepted. The Chief Financial Officer and the General Manager, acting together, shall cause the subscribed capital to be paid into the Company's designated capital-contribution account in installments permissible by law and the Articles. No capital may be returned or reduced without a shareholders' resolution. Where required for the construction qualification application, the Board shall procure a statutory capital verification report from a qualified accounting firm.
2. Registered Office: The registered office is fixed at the domicile stated in the incorporation registration. The Board authorizes the General Manager to execute and file any notice or change of registered office with the competent registry, to affix the corporate seal for such filings, and to maintain all statutory registers and the seal-management policy at that office.
3. Banking Authorization: The Board authorizes the opening of one basic deposit account, general settlement accounts, a capital-contribution account, and foreign-exchange settlement accounts with commercial banks lawfully operating in China. The General Manager, Chief Financial Officer and Legal Representative are appointed as authorized account signatories. Any payment or transfer shall require two signatures, one of which must be the Chief Financial Officer or General Manager. The named officers may execute payment instructions, acceptance mandates, foreign-exchange purchase or sale forms, letter-of-credit applications, and bank guarantee documents where previously approved by the Board.
4. Statutory Officers: The Board resolves to appoint [ ] as General Manager, [ ] as Chief Financial Officer, [ ] as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, and [ ] as Supervisor or member of the supervisory board, each with the authority and duties stated in the Articles. The General Manager and Chief Financial Officer, jointly with any other director, are authorized to sign contracts, employment agreements, insurance policies, qualification filings, tax filings and other official documents.
5. General Execution: The Company Secretary shall certify this resolution, record the minutes of the Board meeting, and issue certified copies. This resolution is effective immediately and remains in force until lawfully revoked or amended by a subsequent resolution of the Board.
Certified true and correct.
[Chairperson Signature]
[Date]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Name Reservation and Foreign-Investment Access Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation through the name pre-registration module of the National Enterprise One-Window Registration Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed enterprise names through the name pre-registration module of the local municipal Administration for Market Regulation. The applicant must adopt an administrative-division prefix, a distinctive business-name kernel, the industry descriptor airport-runway-asphalt-paving, and the corporate suffix Co., Ltd. The platform performs an automatic conflict and prohibited-words check against the national enterprise name database. Because a foreign investment is involved, upload a notarized and consular-legalized certificate of incorporation of the sole foreign shareholder and that shareholder's board resolution authorizing the WFOE formation. Confirm that the proposed business scope does not fall within any restricted category listed in the Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access; if a restricted category is detected, suspend the filing until special approval is obtained or narrow the scope to a permitted activity.
required_dossiers: Three proposed enterprise names in digital form
Notarized and consular-legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign shareholder
Board resolution of the foreign shareholder authorizing establishment of the WFOE
Power of attorney appointing the local formation agent, if any
Scanned passport or identity document of the proposed legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, the applicant shall promptly access the online correction function, submit three new candidates, and re-enter the acceptance queue; if the Negative List query flags a restricted sector, the applicant may apply for special approval through the applicable government window or revise the business scope to exclude the restricted activity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registration acceptance window of the local Administration for Market Regulation; online through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform one-window company formation module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name reservation is issued, complete the Application for Establishment Registration of a Limited Liability Company on the SAMR one-window platform or at the local enterprise registration hall. Execute the Articles of Association before the sole shareholder, and cause every appointed director, legal representative, general manager and supervisor to sign the appointment instruments and specimen-signature declarations. The registered office must be evidenced by an executed lease, a copy of the property ownership certificate, and the landlord's written consent to business use; the address must match the real-estate registration record. The system will automatically push the filing data to the tax and social-insurance registration modules. No SAMR registration fee is charged. If a correction notice is issued, the applicant has up to 15 calendar days to cure the deficiency before the application is withdrawn.
required_dossiers: Signed Application for Establishment Registration of a Limited Liability Company
Duly executed Articles of Association
Executed lease agreement and copy of property ownership certificate for the registered office
Landlord's written consent to business registration use
Passport or identity copies and specimen signatures of directors, legal representative, general manager and supervisor
Statutory appointment instruments for all officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a materials-correction or query notice, the applicant shall submit the corrected electronic dossier within 15 calendar days; an extension may be requested from the local SAMR acceptance officer, and after correction the application is re-entered without losing the name reservation if the reserved name remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Engraving, Tax Registration, Social Insurance and Housing Fund Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving facility; Provincial Tax Service of the State Taxation Administration; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; local Housing Provident Fund Centre
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Take the original Business License to a Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving facility to produce the company seal, financial seal, contract seal, human-resources seal, and the legal representative's private seal. The engraver will register all seals in the public-security seal database. Then, through the province's electronic tax bureau, complete the tax registration and activate the relevant tax types, including value-added tax, corporate income tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, stamp tax, and any local surcharges. On the same multi-license integration screen, submit the social-insurance registration to the local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau and the housing-fund registration to the local Housing Provident Fund Centre. Print the electronic tax registration certificate and social-insurance confirmation records. Any inconsistency in the legal representative's passport data must be cured by submission of original identity documents at the relevant service window.
required_dossiers: Original Business License with unified social credit code
Seal registration specimen card from the approved engraver
Legal representative's passport or resident identity document
Electronic tax registration data ledger generated by the SAMR one-window portal
Social-insurance and housing-fund contributor information form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax or social-security module rejects the data push, the applicant shall visit the tax service hall or the local HRSS window with the Business License and the legal representative's original passport to re-initiate the registration; if the seal registration is incomplete, the engraver must upload the seal specimen again before further filings are accepted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Exchange Direct Investment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank chosen by the Company, acting as reporting agent to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE); confirmation by local SAFE division if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: At a licensed commercial bank, open a basic deposit account using the original Business License, all registered seals, the Articles of Association, and the legal representative's passport. The same bank, acting as a reporting agent for SAFE, processes the foreign-direct-investment registration and opens a foreign-exchange capital account for the WFOE. The sole foreign shareholder must remit the subscribed capital according to the capital-contribution schedule in the Articles; the bank will check the Negative List compliance statement and issue the FDI registration notice. Thereafter, the Company shall file its paid-in capital information in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System. No escrow account is required by national law, but the Company should procure a capital verification report from a certified public accountant before applying for construction-qualification licensing in order to avoid delay or rejection of the qualification application.
required_dossiers: Original Business License and registered seal card
Articles of Association and incorporation registration notice
FDI registration form and negative-list compliance statement
Capital remittance plan and bank account-opening application forms
Notarized and legalized identity documents of the foreign sole shareholder
Certificate of appointment of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE rejects the FDI registration, the applicant must correct the negative-list compliance statement or the capital-receipt documents and may approach the SAFE desk within the bank to request rectification; a resubmission does not restart or invalidate the already completed SAMR company registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Construction Enterprise Qualification and Airport Flight-Area Licensing Preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD); regional office of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) for airport flight-area entry and construction-work permission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before undertaking any runway-paving contract, submit an application to the provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development for a Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate under the appropriate construction or municipal/public-works category, and simultaneously apply for a Construction Enterprise Safety Production License. Provide proof of registered capital or paid-in capital, technical-equipment invoices for pavers, asphalt-spreading equipment, compaction rollers, and temperature-control devices, and evidence of employment of qualified project managers and technical personnel. For airport flight-area operations, file the construction work plan with the regional CAAC office and obtain the airport proprietor's site-entry and work-permit authorization. The competent authority will inspect any on-site asphalt mixing plant or tank farm for environmental and fire-safety compliance before issuing the certificate.
required_dossiers: Construction enterprise qualification application form
Business License and company seal
Capital verification report issued by a licensed public accounting firm
Technical personnel qualification certificates and employment contracts
Ownership or leasing invoices for paving and compaction equipment
Safety-production responsibility system and site risk ledger
CAAC or airport operator site-entry and construction-work permit application, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the construction-qualification application is suspended, the applicant shall submit supplementary evidence within the statutory cure period; if the rejection is based on erroneous evaluation of personnel or assets, the applicant may request an administrative review from the provincial MOHURD or lodge an administrative reconsideration or appeal in accordance with the Administrative Reconsideration Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD); regional office of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC); municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment; local Fire and Rescue Division of the Emergency Management Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate (Construction General Contractor or Municipal Engineering category), Construction Enterprise Safety Production License, and CAAC airport flight-area entry/work permission for runway asphalt-paving operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) through the provincial and municipal Ecology and Environment Bureaus
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Mandatory. If the project includes an on-site hot-mix asphalt plant, bitumen storage tanks, aggregate crushing equipment, or volatile organic compound emission sources, a Full Environmental Impact Report (EIR) is required under the EIA Classification List for Construction Projects. If the project is limited to construction and paving without such ancillary plants, an Environmental Impact Report Form (EIRF) is generally required; no pure-exemption is available for asphalt runways in an airport operating area.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Under GB 16297-1996, stack non-methane hydrocarbon (NMHC) limit is 120 mg/m³ and fugitive boundary NMHC is 4.0 mg/m³; particulate matter at the construction-site boundary must remain at or below 1.0 mg/m³. Process wastewater from asphalt flushing and equipment cleaning shall be recycled or closed-loop; if discharged to a municipal sewer, the effluent must satisfy pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 500 mg/L and suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L under GB/T 31962-2015. Hazardous bitumen and asphalt residues must be stored in leak-proof containment and transported only by duly licensed hazardous-waste carriers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification is mandatory through Fire-Protection Acceptance Filing or Fire-Safety Inspection for the asphalt-mixing plant, fuel storage, bitumen-tank farm and site-living quarters; structures housing hazardous substances must receive Civil Defense review where applicable. Construction-site safety is cleared through the Construction Enterprise Safety Production License, structural-load inspection for silos, bitumen tanks and equipment platforms, occupational exposure monitoring for thermal bitumen fumes and benzene-soluble matter, and mandatory use of heat-resistant personal protective equipment for asphalt-paving workers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; official online filing portal: Electronic Tax Bureau (eTax) web platform, supplemented by the National Electronic Invoice Service Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) formed as a limited liability company in mainland China, the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) printed by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) on the business license is the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), replacing the old separate tax registration certificate. The WFOE must first complete incorporation with SAMR; within 30 days of receipt of the business license it must complete taxpayer registration, taxpayer type determination, bank account filing, accounting system filing, legal representative and financial officer records, and tax collection district assignment through the Electronic Tax Bureau. It must also register for VAT, determine small-scale versus general VAT taxpayer status, and enroll in the nationwide electronic invoice system as a tax-control invoice issuer. A foreign non-resident enterprise without a Chinese permanent establishment that performs taxable activities in China or receives China-source income must apply for a non-resident enterprise taxpayer identification number through the Electronic Tax Bureau, or must be registered by its Chinese payer/withholding agent at the place where the income arises, under the temporary taxpayer registration procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The WFOE is a resident enterprise under PRC tax law, because it is incorporated under PRC law and its place of effective management is in China; it is taxed on worldwide income under the Enterprise Income Tax Law at the 25% corporate income tax rate and cannot be classified as a pass-through entity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; China does not have U.S.-style check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch entity classifications. The only relevant elections are VAT-status elections: a newly established entity may elect to be a small-scale VAT taxpayer below the registration threshold, or may voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer if statutory conditions are met, enabling input-VAT crediting and export zero-rating.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Chinese Value-Added Tax (VAT) with supplementary city maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, stamp tax, and land use taxes where applicable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 of annual taxable turnover for mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer; construction services such as airport runway asphalt paving are generally subject to 9% VAT when the site is in mainland China.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The WFOE must issue VAT invoices exclusively through the STA's National Electronic Invoice Service Platform or through licensed tax-control digital issuance devices connected to the STA's invoice clearance/checking system. Fully digitalized electronic invoices are transmitted to the tax authorities in near real time with encrypted tax-control coding and anti-counterfeiting digital stamping. Special VAT invoices, where input-credit entitlement is claimed by the buyer, must be uploaded and verified in the national VAT invoice system before an input-VAT credit can be recognized. Invoices for construction services must specify the construction service tax classification, project details, rate, amount, and tax output; cross-regional construction activities require project location reporting for inter-jurisdictional VAT allocation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A Chinese WFOE that is registered as a general VAT taxpayer may zero-rate qualifying exports of goods and qualifying cross-border services. Under the VAT reform framework (including Ministry of Finance and STA circulars implementing zero-rating and exemption for cross-border taxable services), construction and project-management services physically performed outside mainland China for an overseas customer, including airport runway asphalt paving works, are eligible for 0% VAT if the services are not consumed in China, the WFOE maintains separate accounting for zero-rated turnover, and a valid cross-border service contract is retained. Goods physically exported from China are zero-rated upon customs export clearance. Services performed inside mainland China, including domestic airport runway paving, are domestic taxable services subject to 9% VAT and do not qualify for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (bill of entry) as electronically accepted, inspected and cleared by China Customs, evidencing the export of goods and equipment for the asphalt paving project
Bill of lading, airway bill, or multimodal transport waybill issued by the carrier showing the exported goods left mainland China and identifying the overseas destination
Commercial contract, detailed sales invoice, packing list, and, for works, construction contract with the overseas airport/employer

Inward remittance certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-exchange receipt statement verifying that the export proceeds have been received from the overseas buyer in accordance with SAFE foreign exchange collection verification requirements
Payment reconciliation and customs/foreign-exchange matching report showing the link between the customs-cleared goods and the repatriated foreign currency

Evidence of overseas project performance for zero-rated construction services, including the foreign worksite certification, employer acceptance certificate, and proof that no taxable service was supplied in China
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA conducts post-clearance audit and cross-matching among customs declaration data, VAT invoice data, and SAFE foreign exchange receipt data. If the claimed export zero-rating or refund lacks the required customs, transport, foreign-exchange, or offshore project-consumption documentation, or is found to be fraudulent, the zero-rated basis is reversed and the output VAT on the underlying consideration is recaptured at the domestic rate, together with surcharges, late-payment interest at 0.05% per day, and an administrative penalty of 50% to 300% of the underpaid tax under Articles 63 and 64 of the PRC Tax Administration and Collection Law. Cases involving forged export declarations or fabricated offshore construction contracts constitute criminal export-fraud under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law and may result in imprisonment, criminal fines, and permanent disqualification from export tax refund treatment, in addition to extraterritorial anti-corruption and AML review for the entity and its shareholders.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) as the central monetary authority, with operational foreign exchange administration delegated to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) and its local branches.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is convertible on the current account for permitted trade in goods and services, including cross-border construction and engineering services, provided the underlying transaction is genuine and documented. The capital account, by contrast, remains subject to a registration-and-approval regime under SAFE. A WFOE's inbound equity capital must be received in accordance with the foreign investment record-filing, converted through a bank-designated capital settlement account, and verified by a certified public accountant before the funds are deemed paid-in. Repatriation of profit to the offshore shareholder requires audited financial statements, an enterprise income tax clearance and withholding tax payment, a board resolution approving distribution, and a SAFE-confirmed foreign exchange bank declaration. For outbound capital account payments such as foreign loans, guarantees, or shareholder advances, separate SAFE registrations and quota approvals are triggered. The system therefore is one of managed convertibility: daily operational liquidity in RMB is free, while cross-border principal movements, repatriation, and netting structures are constrained by documentary proof, real-need principles, anti-reversal controls, and mandatory transaction coding under the Trade and Cross-Border Payment and Receipt System. This creates latency and requires treasury to maintain local RMB liquidity buffers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For an engineering WFOE, overseas contract proceeds from runway paving and related consulting services must be repatriated into China within the statutory period generally 180 days from the date of customs declaration or project completion recognition, unless SAFE agrees to a longer period for long-cycle construction. There is no fixed mandatory conversion ratio: after repatriation to the designated foreign exchange account, the enterprise may retain 100% in approved foreign currency or convert into RMB at market rates through lawful bank channels. All receipts must be truthfully declared under the appropriate current-account trade/service code, supported by the external construction contract, invoice, completion certification, and bank instruction evidence.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI capital settlement account and basic operational RMB foreign currency account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Cross-border project operating account and RMB clearing account
Airport infrastructure project escrow and advance payment account
Regional branch operational account for sub-contractor disbursements and payroll

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital electronic money institutions and non-bank EMIs have virtually no standalone viability for a mainland WFOE as the primary treasury vehicle. PBOC and SAFE require onshore licensed commercial banks to open settlement accounts, monitor FX transaction codes, implement capital registration, and issue the documentary evidence required for auditing and outward remittance. An offshore EMI cannot perform tax withholding, double-taxation treaty statements, SAFE reporting, capital verification, or RMB netting. EMIs are feasible only as a supplemental payment card/wallet channel through a licensed onshore bank, never as the bank of record for cross-border capital or EBITDA repatriation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative of the WFOE must appear physically at the chosen bank branch for the initial corporate KYC interview and account opening, except where the bank accepts a notarized and consularized power of attorney appointing an onshore executive or financial officer. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally permitted on a pure digital basis. For the required interview, the legal representative must present valid passport, Chinese-dependent visa or residence permit, original certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, board resolution, and confirmation of ultimate beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner and nominee shareholding opacity around the offshore parent structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized ownership diagram, passport copies, source-of-wealth statements, bank references, audited financial statements of all natural-person shareholders, and a certificate of good standing from the home registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection does not match the SAFE FDI registration or payment purpose wording
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE foreign investment certificate, market regulator filing receipt, capital contribution schedule, board-approved share subscription document, and mirrored bank statements proving the remitter is the registered shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing statutory operational license for airport runway asphalt paving
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business license listing construction general contracting, airport engineering qualification certificate, specialized asphalt paving sub-license, construction safety permit, and the awarded civil aviation authority project contract.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or adverse media hits against counterparties, subcontractors, or bitumen suppliers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-check and reputational due diligence reports, sanctions/target exposures screened results, passport or corporate registry excerpts for all beneficial owners, and standard contractual representation and warranty clauses backed by shipment, customs, and delivery evidence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder transmits the equity capital via SWIFT MT103 or equivalent wire directly into the WFOE's FDI capital settlement account at an onshore bank. The remittance instruction must reference the approved FDI enterprise registration code and clearly state the purpose as 'investments in China by non-resident' under the SAFE balance-of-payments declaration system. The receiving bank will pre-check that the remitter is the registered shareholder, that the amount is within the approved capital quota, and that no prohibited goods/services are referenced. After receipt, the bank posts the funds as foreign currency or converts to RMB, and the WFOE engages a licensed CPA firm to issue a capital verification report. The report and bank receipt are filed with the market regulation authority and become the basis for later profit repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imported polymer-modified bitumen, emulsifiers, aggregates, specialized machinery, and sub-consultant services, the preferred rail is a SWIFT MT103, subject to ICC rules and the bank's post-verification of purchase invoices, bill of lading/airway bill, construction progress certificate, and tax invoice. For large staged runway construction contracts with foreign EPC partners, a commercial letter of credit under UCP600 should be issued, payable against an engineer's certificate and shipping documents. Documentary collections under URC522 are acceptable for low-risk intra-group purchases. All outbound payments must carry the correct current-account trade/service purpose code and must not be used to repay related-party offshore liabilities without SAFE registration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Delivery-based onshore forward foreign exchange settlement and sale contracts with a licensed onshore bank, limited to the WFOE's genuine current-account or registered capital account exposure.
Cross-currency swaps (principally exchanged) used only to hedge a documented foreign-currency loan or investment cash flow with the corresponding SAFE registration.
European-style onshore FX options with physical delivery and zero leverage, used solely for known receivable or payable dates.

Offshore non-deliverable forward contracts are not permissible as a common WFOE hedging root; any NDF-like contract would require a specific SAFE-approved demonstration of inability to use the onshore deliverable market.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Disclosure Report (annual return of the WFOE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from January 1 to June 30 for the prior fiscal year; for fiscal year 2024, the report is due by June 30, 2025
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or non-filing triggers inclusion on SAMR's List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations within 10 working days after June 30; if the omission is not cured within 3 years, the entity is transferred to the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, public procurement and tax credit restrictions apply, and SAMR may administratively revoke the business license as an administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report for Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, shared with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually January 1 through June 30 for the immediately preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Interim Measures for Foreign Investment Information Reporting, failure to submit or false submission is remedied by a rectification order within 20 days; non-compliance thereafter attracts a fine of CNY 200,000 (approximately USD 27,600), which increases to CNY 500,000 (approximately USD 69,000) for serious cases, plus SAMR abnormal-listing and possible license revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year following each PRC tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of CNY 2,000 to CNY 10,000, a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax, collection enforcement, restrictions on the enterprise tax credit rating, and prevention of the WFOE from completing deregistration; material false reporting may additionally trigger criminal liability and temporary license suspension by SAMR.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory audited financial statements and independent certified public accountant audit report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: WFOE shareholders' general meeting; retained at the registered office and produced to SAMR, STA, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange on lawful demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the fiscal year-end for financial statement approval, and in any event before the May 31 annual corporate income tax final settlement deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to procure the mandatory audit breaches the PRC Company Law and the WFOE's accounting and foreign-exchange administration obligations; the company can be subject to administrative corrective orders, fines, adverse SAMR publicity, and obstacles to annual foreign-exchange verification, capital account remittance, and business license extension or renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Construction enterprise qualification and safety-production annual compliance attestation and annual construction statistics submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial or municipal Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) and the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) where airport runway works are performed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual statistical and qualification report filed by the statutory industrial-statistical deadline, generally no later than March 31 following the close of the calendar year; safety-production permit conditions must be continuously maintained throughout the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain qualification headcount, asset, or technical conditions or to file required annual construction statistics leads to a corrective order, downgrade of the airport runway specialized contracting qualification, suspension of bidding rights, and in serious cases revocation of the construction enterprise qualification certificate or safety production permit; CAAC may also suspend the contractor from civil-aviation works.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: PRC law has no quantitative balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Limited Liability Company: the PRC Company Law requires every company to prepare annual financial reports and have them audited by a certified public accountant. Therefore a WFOE of any size engaged in airport runway asphalt paving is mandatorily audited; even where a small WFOE applies the Small Enterprise Accounting Standard, the audit must be performed by a licensed PRC CPA firm and the audited statements must comply with PRC accounting requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE / Chinese GAAP), which are substantially converged with IFRS; construction licenseholders additionally apply ASBE on construction contracts and the Ministry of Finance construction-industry accounting regulations; small WFOEs may prepare under the Small Enterprise Accounting Standard where eligible, but IFRS statements are not accepted for the statutory PRC audit unless reconciled to Chinese GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PBOC and SAMR Beneficial Ownership Information Management Measures effective November 1, 2024, a WFOE must identify beneficial owners and file their particulars in the SAMR beneficial-owner database; a fresh report is required within 30 days of any change in ownership, voting rights, or senior-management control, while the SAMR annual enterprise report serves as the annual confirmation of the prior-year equity and control structure. Any equity transfer must be registered with SAMR as a change of registration within 30 days after the transfer is executed; failure to do so cannot be asserted against third parties and subjects the WFOE to abnormal-operations listing and fines under the anti-money-laundering and market-registration regimes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders and Board Meetings
Register of Share Transfers (Equity Transfer Ledger)
Registered Articles of Association, Seal Ledger, and Resolution File

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 2,500 per year in tier-1 and tier-2 Chinese cities
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 20,000 per year depending on transaction volume, revenue, and airport-runway contract size

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law standard rate is 25%. A reduced 15% rate may apply for certified High-and-New Technology Enterprises; an alternative 15% encouraged-industry rate applies in Western China; no automatic national tax holiday remains for wholly foreign-owned enterprises after the 2008 EIT Law harmonization. Qualifying R&D expenditure receives a 100% super-deduction (equal to 200% deduction) where the underlying asphalt-modification and low-carbon paving technology research has commercial viability. Investment tax credits under public infrastructure or environmental protection rules may be available if the runway paving contract qualifies as a public infrastructure project, but airport runway paving is generally not a listed preferential industrial sector without an administrative certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Return Form A100000 (Type A) together with supporting schedules, filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing portal ('e-tax' electronic system). Quarterly provisional CIT filings are made on Form A200000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with four quarterly provisional prepayments; the annual return is a single comprehensive filing consolidating the four quarterly payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments must be made within 15 days after each calendar quarter-end; the annual CIT return must be filed and the balance settled within 5 months after the close of the fiscal year, i.e., by May 31 of the following year for a calendar-year taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Taxpayer Legal Identity and Shareholding
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter legal name, unified social credit code, tax registration address, legal representative, date of incorporation, industry classification, and direct/indirect non-resident shareholding percentages.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the WFOE as a Chinese mainland tax resident filing on worldwide revenue derived from China-source contracts. Disclose all non-resident parent and ultimate beneficial shareholders with their treaty jurisdiction. Inaccurate nominee disclosure triggers anti-avoidance audits and denial of DTA benefits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Accounting Basis and Fiscal Year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State the accounting standard, calendar-year period, accrual basis, and functional currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The annual reporting period must be the Chinese calendar year, even if the foreign parent uses a different fiscal year. Revenue from multi-year airport runway asphalt paving contracts must be allocated under PRC construction revenue recognition rules; do not use offshore completion certificates to postpone China-source revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 / Line 1-4 - Business Income, Cost of Sales and Gross Profit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report total revenue from polymer-modified bitumen runway paving, subcontracting, engineering management, and incidental sales; deduct cost of sales including materials, labor, equipment, and subcontract costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All income attributable to a Chinese worksite, including site preparation, asphalt laying, compaction, and certification, is China-source income regardless of where contracts are signed or invoices are issued. If the foreign parent conducts only procurement without site activity, no offshore profit split is permitted without a valid TP study and economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 / Line 5-8 - Deductions and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record administrative expenses, marketing expenses, depreciation, financing charges, management fees, royalties and other overheads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent management fees, technical assistance fees, and royalties are deductible only where supported by an arm's-length service agreement, actual benefit, and contemporaneous documentation. Payments made to a shell affiliate without dedicated staff, project supervision, or identifiable value-added functions are non-deductible and are recharacterized as disguised dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Non-Deductible Items and Tax Adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back fines, penalties, non-compliant entertainment expenses, related-party interest above thin capitalization limits, illegal invoices, and excessive administrative charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Business entertainment is deductible only to 60% of actual spend, capped at 0.5% of same-year sales revenue. Intercompany interest from non-financial related parties cannot exceed a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio unless an exemption certificate is obtained. Cross-border guarantee fees and cash-pooling arrangement fees must be separately justified.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Loss Carryforward and Adjusted Taxable Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduct qualifying prior-year tax losses against current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Chinese source operating losses may be carried forward five years; certified high-tech companies may use the ten-year extension. A WFOE cannot use treaty or offshore group loss pooling to offset China taxable income. A transfer pricing adjustment in a prior audit will also revise the carryforward position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Taxable Income, Rate and Preferential Rate Application
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the applicable tax rate to taxable income after adjustments and loss offsets; claim any 15% preferential rate or 20% small-low-profit regime if legally qualified.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-owned construction entities normally bear 25%, with no automatic foreign investor tax holiday. If a preferential 15% rate is claimed for high-tech certification, the WFOE must hold the valid certificate, R&D records, core proprietary technology ownership, and at least 60% qualifying revenue from certifying products.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Quarterly Prepayments and Balance Due/Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record the four quarterly provisional CIT payments and calculate final tax payable or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Underpayment of provisional installments causes statutory daily interest and may itself trigger an audit. Dividends paid out of current-year profits must be recorded after CIT is computation-complete; any dividend distribution exceeding the after-tax retained earnings account is non-compliant capital distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 - Related Party Transactions and Transfer Pricing Schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclose all related-party transactions, including bitumen purchases, asphalt technology royalties, equipment leases, management fees, interest, loan receivables/payables, and cost-sharing arrangements, with foreign affiliates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Schedule on Related Party Transactions and Transfer Pricing (Form A107000 and associated schedules) to identify each cross-border related party, transaction type, amount, pricing methodology, and applicable profit-level indicator. Failure to disclose the foreign parent's tax jurisdiction or to file statutory Local File / Master File by the disclosure deadline creates an automatic special tax adjustment exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: tax authorities may impose a penalty of RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000-20,000 in serious cases, plus daily late-payment interest equal to 0.05% of the outstanding tax under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Arts. 32 and 62. Fraudulent or false tax filings trigger the Tax Collection Administration Law Art. 63 recovery of unpaid tax plus a penalty of 50%-500% of the evaded amount, and referral for criminal prosecution under PRC Criminal Law Art. 201 where the evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and more than 10% of the tax payable. Failure to withhold non-resident tax under Art. 69 exposes the withholding agent to penalties of 50%-300% of the unwithheld amount.
